address: 9 rue de Beg-Er-Vir, Lomener, Ploemeur, 56270, France
bio: In this restaurant facing the open sea, the cuisine showcases fish and seafood (of course!). With the island of Groix as a backdrop, guests could almost dip their toes in the water while the chef serves up extremely fresh fish dishes, from a menu interspersed with a few modern touches....
